capabilities: Answer questions with grounded RAG chat
Reshape selections and restructure notes with an LLM
Suggest and insert wikilinks from the index
extras: Not distributed through Obsidian's community directory; installed via the AnySource Sideloader catalog or manually. The plugin API (version 1) is explicitly experimental. Some diagnostic strings remain in German and are being cleaned up. Sibling plugin image-to-markdown handles image transcription. Cross-device index sync requires Obsidian Sync's 'Sync all other file types'; API keys are stored in Obsidian's keychain and do not sync. The MCP server is desktop only.
problem: Obsidian's built-in search only matches keywords, so finding notes by meaning or getting answers grounded in your vault isn't possible.

relations.evidence: If the LLM Lab plugin is installed, Vault Retrieval reports its LLM calls to it
retrieval backend for MCP clients (Claude Code, OpenClaw, …)

requires.name: OpenAI-compatible embedding endpoint (local like Ollama or hosted)
OpenAI-compatible chat LLM endpoint (local like LM Studio or hosted)
Hosted provider API key (OpenRouter, Groq, OpenAI, Mistral, etc.)

summary: Local retrieval plugin adding related notes, semantic search, and grounded RAG chat over your vault via a synced embedding index.
